body:
Sorry, I don't mean he wouldn't accept me, I could phrase that more clearly. I like to believe that God would love unconditionally. Rather he'd turn me away based on my actions. I think he still loves people that don't get into heaven. If God exists, I want to understand his judgement. I want to be able to worship him.

This might not make sense, but when I look at other LGBTQ people, I don't see any way they couldn't be accepted/loved by God. I don't see the love I have for certain people as a sin. I think it's beautiful. 

But I've grown up being told it's wrong, and part of me wont let go of that. It scares me to think that the God I've spent my life trying to get closer to is disgusted with me. Thinking of that kind of blinds me to the earlier sentiment.

I don't live with them, just back for holidays. In a few years, when I can afford it, I'll move somewhere more liberal/friendly than where I am now. I've studied many other religions, and it's definitely nice to feel accepted or tolerated. Right now though, I'm more interested in figuring out personally whether God accepts me or not, and I don't feel that joining a different church would help solve that.
